title: lore check and sync take an advisory lock per git common dir, with result reuse and stale-holder recovery
description: DEC-282 item 2, filed from ODOC-610 (opum-doc, 2026-11-18T23:03Z). VERBATIM: 'lore-cli: an advisory lock per git common dir for check and sync. A waiter with matching tree hashes reuses the finished result, and a stale holder never blocks forever.' CONTEXT from the report: four to five concurrent runs made about 45 quest processes and a load of about 128, and on 2026-11-12 that shut the fleet down; any quest write staled the lore:tasks rollup, so lore check exited 6 and everyone re-ran sync and check defensively. The lock must span worktrees of one clone, which is why it lives in the git common dir rather than the checkout. Ships in the next lore/quest pair (DEC-282 items 1-4 ship together).

acceptanceCriteria.text: check and sync take an advisory lock in the git common dir, so worktrees of one clone contend on the same lock.
A waiter whose tree hashes match a finished result reuses that result instead of recomputing.
A stale holder never blocks a waiter forever; the recovery is measured and bounded.
Both ways: two concurrent runs produce one compute and one reuse, and a stale lock is recovered rather than hanging.
Measured at about 2000 tasks: concurrent runs no longer multiply quest processes.
